svg.title: cc2codex - hand off a half-finished coding session between Claude Code and Codex
svg.desc: Claude Code and Codex hand a session to each other: cc2codex turns a Claude Code session into a local HANDOFF.md that Codex reads, and codex2cc does the reverse. The document carries your requests, tasks and plan, changed files, and the last steps.

g.aria-label: One local handoff doc. No model calls.
